verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs clearly show role/permission definition (default admin/member roles plus custom roles and fine-grained permissions) scoped to Organizations, and session tokens carry org context including memberships, roles, and active organization for authorization checks (clerk-docs-4/17/21/24/34, clerk-docs-6/22/32). However, community feedback specifically calls out that Clerk's RBAC model ties roles to organizations rather than storing them directly on the user, which some developers consider 'not proper RBAC' for non-org use cases (clerk-comm-3), a real caveat on scope. Missing for 10: independent verification of permission claims actually appearing as JWT claims usable in arbitrary backend authorization code, and support for user-level (non-org) roles.
